title: Manufactured Home Insurance Policy Forms: Covered Perils and Loss Valuation
content:
Manufactured Home Insurance is written by Hearthstone Insurance Agency in six policy forms. Each form fixes three things about the coverage on the resident's home: which perils the dwelling coverage answers for, how a dwelling loss and a personal property loss are valued, and which optional protections come built in.

## Covered-perils forms

| Perils form | What the dwelling coverage answers for |
|---|---|
| Basic | The named perils fire, lightning, windstorm, hail, explosion and smoke |
| Broad | Every basic peril, plus falling objects, weight of snow, water discharge and freezing |
| Special | All risks of direct physical loss that are not excluded |

## Form schedule

| Policy form | Perils form | Dwelling loss valued at | Extended replacement ceiling | Personal property valued at | Sewer and drain backup limit | Equipment breakdown |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Actual Cash Value | Basic | Actual cash value | Not applicable | Actual cash value | $0 (not included) | Not covered |
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Replacement Cost | Basic | Replacement cost | Not applicable | Actual cash value | $0 (not included) | Not covered |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Actual Cash Value | Broad | Actual cash value | Not applicable | Actual cash value | $0 (not included) | Not covered |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Replacement Cost | Broad | Replacement cost | Not applicable | Replacement cost | $0 (not included) | Not covered |
| Manufactured Home Special Form - Replacement Cost | Special | Replacement cost | Not applicable | Replacement cost | $0 (not included) | Not covered |
| Manufactured Home Special Form Plus - Extended Replacement Cost | Special | Extended replacement cost | 125% of the dwelling limit | Replacement cost | $5000 | Covered |

## Notes to the schedule

- **Extended replacement ceiling.** Under extended replacement cost the most the carrier pays on a dwelling loss is a percentage of the dwelling limit; on the Manufactured Home Special Form Plus - Extended Replacement Cost that percentage is 125%. The ceiling does not apply to any form that values the dwelling at actual cash value or plain replacement cost.
- **Sewer and drain backup.** A limit of $0 means the coverage is not included in the form. Only the Special Form Plus includes it, at $5000.
- **Equipment breakdown.** Breakdown of home systems and appliances is covered only on the Special Form Plus.
- **Two valuations on one policy.** Dwelling and personal property are valued separately: the Manufactured Home Basic Form - Replacement Cost values the dwelling at replacement cost but personal property at actual cash value.

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

*Ceiling on the Special Form Plus.* A hypothetical dwelling limit of $100,000 on the Manufactured Home Special Form Plus - Extended Replacement Cost gives a most-payable dwelling amount of 125% of that limit, that is $125,000. The same $100,000 limit on the Manufactured Home Special Form - Replacement Cost carries no extended ceiling.

*Peril questions answered from the schedule.*

- Is weight of snow a covered peril on a Basic form? No; it is not among the basic named perils. It is named among the perils the broad form adds.
- Does any Broad form include sewer and drain backup? No; both Broad forms show a $0 backup limit.
